name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Combine.tag_free_consistent
title: Whole-string consistency tags: every tag-cancelling combination of mixed two-pass evaluations equals a combination of consistent evaluations
statement: Mixed evaluations V(a,b) = m + h a - h b - C1 a - C2 b. If the integer coefficients c_j cancel the formal coefficient of every tag h x (sum over a_j = x equals sum over b_j = x), then sum_j c_j V(a_j,b_j) = sum_x omega(x) (m - C1 x - C2 x) with omega(x) the sum of c_j over a_j = x.
